result.summary: The intersection features a marked zebra crosswalk with pedestrian signals and traffic lights, providing basic crossing protection. However, the wide roadway and lack of a median refuge island increase pedestrian exposure to multi-lane traffic.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a refuge island, increasing exposure time.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the image at the marked crosswalk.

hazards.name: Construction Obstruction
hazards.description: Orange cones and barriers on the far side of the crossing may partially obstruct the pedestrian path or bus stop access.
hazards.location_in_image: Left background near the bus shelter.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time and provide a safe waiting area.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the roadway at the crossing to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The intersection features marked zebra crosswalks but lacks essential pedestrian infrastructure such as sidewalks, curb ramps, and pedestrian signals. The wide roadway and long crossing distances across multiple lanes of traffic create a high-exposure environment for people walking.

hazards.name: Missing Sidewalks
hazards.description: Pedestrians are forced to wait on unpaved, uneven grass and dirt surfaces immediately adjacent to high-speed traffic lanes.
hazards.location_in_image: Corners of the intersection where crosswalks terminate

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated signals for pedestrians are visible, requiring users to interpret vehicle signals to determine when it is safe to cross.

hazards.name: Inaccessible Crossings
hazards.description: The absence of curb ramps and paved landings makes the crossing inaccessible for wheelchair users and a trip hazard for others.
hazards.location_in_image: Crosswalk landings at the road edge

interventions.title: Sidewalk and Curb Ramp Installation
interventions.description: Construct paved sidewalks and ADA-compliant curb ramps at all corners to provide a safe, accessible path and waiting area.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signal Heads
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signals with countdown timers to provide clear right-of-way information and reduce crossing uncertainty.

interventions.title: Median Refuge Island
interventions.description: Enhance the existing grass median with a raised, paved refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross the wide roadway in stages.

result.summary: The image depicts a large, multi-lane intersection that is highly hostile to pedestrians due to a complete lack of marked crossings and pedestrian signals. The wide roadway creates excessive crossing distances without any refuge, prioritizing high-speed vehicular throughput over pedestrian safety.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no marked crosswalks at this signalized intersection, leaving pedestrians with no designated or protected space to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the center of the frame.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The multi-lane roadway requires a very long unprotected crossing, increasing exposure time to high-speed traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: The entire width of the asphalt roadway.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: The intersection has vehicle traffic lights but no visible pedestrian signal heads to indicate when it is safe to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: At the corners of the intersection where signals are mounted.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks on all legs of the intersection to define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing intervals.

interventions.title: Median Refuge Island
interventions.description: Construct a raised median refuge to allow pedestrians to cross the wide roadway in two stages.

result.summary: This intersection is highly hostile to pedestrians, lacking sidewalks, marked crosswalks, and pedestrian signals. The wide roadway and high-speed design prioritize vehicle throughput over pedestrian safety and accessibility.
